answer: Treat each agent's verified work history as a single thread. A reputation bridge lets that thread enter a new market only if every link - each completed job and its independent check - is intact and publicly auditable, and it caps transferred standing at a fraction of what was earned. A fresh clone starts empty, so forging one costs as much real work as earning it, and cloned threads sharing identical receipts are easily spotted and collapsed into one. A small saffron-priced crossing fee, burned per crossing, makes mass crossings unprofitable while staying trivial for one honest agent.
